notes.title: Update notes for Sep. 25 (v1.2.0)
notes.content:
[olist]
 Added hide tutorial text and stamina boost on first enemy chase.
 Reduced difficulty in ball pit.
 Added "minigame" to try catch the balloon on the city.
 Reduced ambush probability on act 1.
 Improved big circus tent outside collisions to better match how it looks.
 Increased labyrinth toy speed on act 2.
 Reduced hint text size.
 Fixed bugs related to the enemy being able to go into the bonfire salt circle.
 Fixed bug that caused the clown to kill you when you were hiding inside a tube.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update notes for September 21 (v1.1.0)
notes.content:
Improved game act pacing for better progression.
 Improved poster spawns in labyrinth.
 Added props to improve entrances in labyrinth and ball pit.
 Fixed minor localization bugs.

notes.title: Mind the Clown - v0.5.0 major update
notes.content:
v0.5.0 Major Update
This is a major update that aims to improve audio, graphics and difficulty before the full release of the game.
Changelog:
Checkpoints.

More time until clown appearances.

Reworked game intro.

Animated cinematics for intro and circus transition.

Adaptive music in the circus.

Improved sound design.

Reduced headbob.

Stamina system.

New poster designs.

The full game is launching in less than a month, any feedback on the game (especially about difficulty) is greatly appreciated 🙏



I am glad to present you part of the circus cast:
